fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on alleged police brutality and official inaction in Miami, including discussion of the Charles Haynes case and related newspaper coverage. Additional pieces address prohibition enforcement and a reprinted/quoted Chicago Daily Tribune editorial on coast guard killings, local civic matters such as Community Chest fundraising and public library funding, and notes on Miami Beach policing. The issue also reports on plans for a marine pageant connected with the Mid-Winter Regatta (route from the Miami River to the causeway and Miami Beach), mentions the opening of a new high school, provides society/visitor arrivals, sports coverage (boxing and other events), and contains extensive local advertising including automobile show promotions.
